title: Windgram cross-model run index, data/runs.json

propertyNames.description: Lowercase hyphenated slug — the identity of models and sites everywhere.

referenceTime.description: The model's currently published run, UTC.

generatedAt.description: When that run's documents were generated, UTC.

runs.description: Model slug -> the manifest's (referenceTime, generatedAt) pair.

description: data/runs.json — the machine-written cross-model run index, keyed by model slug: per published model, its manifest's (referenceTime, generatedAt) pair, regenerated wholesale at every publish. One fetch answers "how fresh is everything"; judge lateness against each model's declared runIntervalHours.
